title: NOmineNOcraft
description: You wanted to craft? NO. You wanted to mine? NO.
body:
Mod NOmineNOcraft Prohibits digging and building.
## Mines
All caves are now made up of blocks labeled "no mine."
![cave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6b55e7b791b474352e80f8de0947d33fa019987_0.webp)
These blocks are indestructible and cannot be detonated; they look like a stone with a line through it.
## block replacement
This mod disables the crafting table, so no more crafting.
![NOcraft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/694076948dd06e9f589a413369932687c3ec9864_0.webp)
This mod also replaces all types of stone, so no more mines.
![NOstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da75748b33a42027eea400d28455c59bc9870de4.png)
